title: Changing Landscape of Materiovigilance: Opportunities & Challenges for Healthcare Professionals
bodyHtml:
NCC-MvPI, IPC in association with NIPER, Hajipur is conducting two days training programme entitled "Changing Landscape of Materiovigilance: Opportunities & Challenges for Healthcare Professionals"on July 6-7, 2023 at NIPER, Hajipur, Bihar
